name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v556: stops mid-episode Cloudflare popups. (1) Invisible mode now stays invisible: only the app-open probe may fall back to the visible TV D-pad sheet; episode-tap and mid-playback probes never pop a sheet. (2) kwik.cx is treated as an embed host — a kwik challenge fails that link silently instead of opening the solver or CloudflareKiller, so no kwik popup interrupts playback. (3) The pre-playback probe now validates the mirror that actually holds the saved cookie (savedAnimePaheHost) instead of hardcoded .pw, which used to open a pointless bypass when the valid cookie was on .org/.com. (4) isCookieValid retries a transient interstitial once before declaring the cookie dead, avoiding false popups mid-episode. (5) All v555 fixes retained: pre-purge clearance snapshot so TV never saves a stale cookie, expanded visible sheet, storedActivity cache, per-host cookies, client hints, D-pad cursor bounds.
